explanation: The Almighty Creator who is the source of all grace and wisdom, and who has exalted Christ above all to fill him with his fullness.
God's undeserved gift of love and goodwill toward humanity, given through Jesus Christ without merit on our part.
Heavenly insight that God has revealed concerning his secret plan to unite all things in Christ.
The divine mystery that Gentiles are now co-heirs and members of the same body together with Jews through the gospel.
The Holy Spirit who gives strength to believers, reveals God's will, and enables them to understand the depth of Christ's love.
The united church where all believers are connected to Christ as the head and to one another as members.
The concept that God, through his grace, has filled human nature with his divine life in Christ to display his multifaceted works of wisdom.
